briefings.title: How Thomson Reuters Achieved ‘Fiduciary-Grade’ AI Accuracy
briefings.tldr: Thomson Reuters President and CEO Steve Hasker outlines how the company leverages "fiduciary-grade AI" and proprietary data to drive growth across the legal, tax, and news sectors without sacrificing accuracy.

briefings.title: He Helped Create Google Drive. This Is What He’s Building Next.
briefings.tldr: Shan Sinha, Co-Founder and CEO of Canopy and former co-founder of DocVerse (which became Google Drive), discusses his journey of persistence through 60 investor rejections, the critical need to protect healthcare workers from rising workplace violence using wearable technology, and why AI will act as a job creator rather than a disruptor.

briefings.title: How Rivian Could Challenge Tesla's EV Dominance
briefings.tldr: Rivian CEO RJ Scaringe outlines how the electric vehicle maker is tackling the "fossil fuel blip" by launching the lower-cost R2 platform to break Tesla's market dominance, while leveraging transformer-based AI to dramatically accelerate the timeline for fully autonomous driving by 2031.

briefings.title: How AI Is Transforming Healthcare, Biotech and the Future of Medicine

people.name: Morgan Cheatham
people.role: Partner & Head of Healthcare and Life Sciences, Breyer Capital

briefings.tldr: AI is transforming healthcare from an art into a computational information science, driving massive efficiencies across diagnostics, clinical trials, and patient care.

briefings.title: Is the Global Economy at a Turning Point? Carlyle CEO Harvey Schwartz Explains
briefings.tldr: The global economy is undergoing a historic inflection point as 80 years of post-WWII globalization and geopolitical cooperation reverse in favor of national security, onshoring, and energy diversification.

briefings.title: Ray Dalio Explains the 5 Forces Shaping the Future of the Global Economy
briefings.tldr: Bridgewater Associates Founder Ray Dalio warns of an impending sovereign debt crisis and a historic shift in global power, advising investors to combat extreme market concentration and geopolitical risk by building portfolios with at least 15 uncorrelated assets.

briefings.title: BREAKING: Elon Musk's First Interview Since Jury Rejected Claim Against Altman's OpenAI
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk predicts that AI will surpass human intelligence in every metric within two years and advocates for moving massive AI data centers into space to harness solar energy, while warning that OpenAI’s transition to a for-profit model sets a "dangerous precedent" for looting charitable organizations.

briefings.title: Marc Lore's Blueprint For Scaling Billion-Dollar Startups

people.name: Marc Lore
people.role: Founder, Chairman, and CEO, Wonder Group

briefings.tldr: Marc Lore is leveraging vertical integration and "physical AI" at Wonder to disrupt the trillion-dollar food industry, utilizing a math-driven scaling framework (VCP) to transition from software-only models to capital-intensive physical infrastructure that creates a defensible market moat.

briefings.title: Meet The CEO Behind This $90 Million Plan Expanding HBCUs In Private Finance
briefings.tldr: AltFinance is a $90 million, 10-year nonprofit initiative backed by Apollo, Ares, and Oaktree to diversify the private investment industry by providing HBCU students with specialized training, mentorship, and career pathways.

briefings.title: Bootstrapped To $1 Billion: How Arizona-Based Lectric eBikes Is Dominating The D2C Market
briefings.tldr: By prioritizing immediate profitability and operational leverage over the traditional venture capital "growth-at-all-costs" model, Levi Conlow has scaled Lectric eBikes to over $1 billion in sales and 700,000 units, securing its position as North America's largest e-bike brand.

briefings.title: Why The OpenAI Legal Battle Could Redefine The Future Of Artificial Intelligence
briefings.tldr: Elon Musk’s $134 billion lawsuit against OpenAI, set for trial in late April, represents a fundamental clash over whether the future of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) should remain a nonprofit public good or a high-capital for-profit enterprise.

briefings.title: Wealth Lessons: How Investor Jacob Walthour Makes Smart Money Moves

people.name: Jacob Walthour
people.role: Co-founder and CEO, Blueprint Capital Advisors

briefings.tldr: Jacob Walthour, CEO of Blueprint Capital Advisors, emphasizes a strategic shift toward energy and AI infrastructure while warning of liquidity "cracks" in private credit, ultimately advocating for aggressive self-investment to navigate AI-driven career displacement.

briefings.title: How This Founder Went From Living In AOL's Offices To Running A Profitable AI Startup
briefings.tldr: StackBlitz transitioned from a struggling $500k ARR developer tool to a $20M ARR AI powerhouse in just two months by pivoting to "Bolt.new," a prompt-to-app platform now used by 75% of the Fortune 500.
